summary: Wave 9.2 — Hyperlocal Discovery Engine. Backend: 26/26 wave9.2 tests pass. Full regression 58/58 pass (test_wave8a_ecosystem + test_discovery + test_sources_center + test_growth + test_wave7_growth + test_wave6_auth_email). Unit assertions: region_score('CO','CO',item_city='Medellín',user_city='Medellín')=90.0; hyperlocal_tier('CO','Bogotá','CO','Medellín')='country'; regional_sort orders Medellín > Bogotá > US. Endpoint assertions: GET /api/discovery/entity/bancolombia/related with X-Region-Country:CO + X-Region-City:Medellín → user_city='Medellín', similar[0] is a CO+Medellín entity (grupo-sura / grupo-nutresa / u-antioquia). With X-Region-City:Bogotá → similar[0] is a CO+Bogotá seed (ecopetrol/avianca/mintic/sena/ccb). Without city → Wave 9 behavior preserved (CO first). ?country=CO&city=Medellín query override works; Medellín-based CO items precede Bogotá-based ones. All 4 new institutions (sena/mintic/camara-comercio-bogota/u-antioquia) return 200 with correct city; CO listing includes all 9 CO seeds. City field on 6 CO companies verified (bancolombia/grupo-sura/grupo-nutresa=Medellín, ecopetrol/avianca=Bogotá, alpina=Sopó). 9 new RSS sources registered with correct country tags. Trending /api/discovery/trending?scope=country with CO+Medellín headers → all CO items regional_weight=1.0. PATCH /me/region {country:'CO', city:'Medellín'} persists and /me returns both; subsequent /related infers CO+Medellín. GET /region/detect with CO IP returns city. Frontend on fresh visitor (localStorage cleared): region chip resolves within 6s; data-testid='workspace-region-city' shows detected city ('Council Bluffs' from US datacenter egress, as expected — matches spec 'city may be omitted when IP-lookup returns no city, but if returned, it's shown'); data-testid='workspace-region-method' shows 'AUTO'; localStorage['pcone_country']=US, localStorage['pcone_city']='Council Bluffs' both persisted. Trending Companies widget still visible, feed loads without errors.

minor.issue: CommunityUserPublic schema was missing `city` field — PATCH /me/region persisted city to DB but response body and /me omitted it. FIXED in-place: added `city: Optional[str] = None` to CommunityUserPublic and threaded user.get('city') through _user_to_public().

critical_code_review_comments: regional.py::regional_sort is a stable Python sort keyed on tier_rank[hyperlocal_tier(...)] — this is correct and preserves upstream order inside each tier. Good.
regional.py::hyperlocal_tier normalizes city via lowercase/strip which correctly handles Bogotá==bogotá / MEDELLÍN==medellín; test confirms case-insensitivity works.
discovery_routes._resolve_user_context reads city from (1) query override, (2) user profile, (3) X-Region-City header — priority chain mirrors country resolver. Clean.

resolver.gather() now applies regional_sort with user_city to news/videos/jobs/events/similar/people. If any of these collections carry no `city` field, the sort still returns country-tier items which is correct fallback behavior.

seeds.py adds 4 new CO institutions with vertical='instituciones' — verify this vertical exists in models_category (the file docstring notes 'Verticals used here MUST exist in models_category.DEFAULT_CATEGORIES; empresas is the safe umbrella'). All 4 return 200 and pass tests, so the vertical is registered or ignored; still worth confirming no filter breaks elsewhere.

growth/sources.py — 4 of the 9 new central-bank feeds (banrep.gov.co, banxico.org.mx, bcrp.gob.pe, bde.es) are likely to fail live scrape from preview datacenter due to institutional firewalls (per spec note). Not tested for live scrape success as per instructions; only registration/tagging tested — passes.

MINOR (fixed): CommunityUserPublic previously did not expose the `city` field — PATCH /me/region wrote it to Mongo but response and GET /me omitted it. Added `city: Optional[str] = None` to the schema and threaded through _user_to_public().

SUGGESTION carried over from iteration_24: CommunityUserPublic still doesn't expose country_source, so authed users lose the AUTO badge on hard reload (chip logic depends on client-side detectedMethod state). Consider exposing country_source too — same one-line addition.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (city pill + AUTO badge + localStorage persistence verified)

test_credentials: member.demo@puntocero.test-e2e.com / MemberDemo2026 (verified). Test PATCHes user to {country:CO, city:Medellín}; state is left with CO+Medellín (safe — spec compatible).
seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeds (4 new CO institutions + city field on 6 CO companies) already loaded on backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 9.2 backend is complete and stable. Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_wave9_2_hyperlocal.py (26 tests). Note: one transient network timeout occurred on test_search_populated in a full regression run but the same test passed on retry — treat as flaky env, not code. If iterating on this feature, remember: (1) city compare is case-insensitive (Bogotá==bogotá); (2) frontend depends on Playwright container's egress IP — US datacenter → US country + Council Bluffs city, which is spec-compliant (city may be omitted or reflect IP); (3) I fixed CommunityUserPublic to return city — please retain across future waves; country_source is still not exposed (see review comment).
rca of the issue: PATCH /me/region {city:'Medellín'} response omitted city because CommunityUserPublic pydantic model didn't declare a `city` field and _user_to_public() didn't project it. Fix: two-line schema addition + one-line dict copy. Verified with retest — /me now returns both country and city, and subsequent /related correctly infers CO+Medellín from cookie session without any headers.
